name: Footnote Change Classification Taxonomy & Severity Rubric

categories.name: Accounting Policy Change
categories.definition: Alterations in accounting principles, methods of adoption (e.g., modified retrospective vs full retrospective), revenue recognition criteria, or depreciation/amortization methodology.
categories.materiality_rationale: Directly changes reported figures across comparison periods and impacts fundamental valuation models.

categories.name: New Disclosure
categories.definition: Disclosures, tables, or notes appearing in the current period that were entirely absent in the prior comparison filing.
categories.materiality_rationale: Signals new business lines, emerging legal liabilities, newly originated debt tranches, or regulatory investigations.

categories.name: Removed Disclosure
categories.definition: Information, tables, or commitments present in the previous filing that have been omitted without an explicit explanation.
categories.materiality_rationale: Could indicate resolution of a risk or an intentional omission of adverse conditions.

categories.name: Risk Factor Change
categories.definition: Modifications to contingencies, litigation reserves, concentration of credit risk, or supply-chain dependencies.
categories.materiality_rationale: Directly impacts discount rates and downside scenarios.

categories.name: Estimate Revision
categories.definition: Changes in management assumptions, discount rates, fair value hierarchy levels (Level 1/2/3 inputs), credit loss allowances (CECL), or impairment testing models.
categories.materiality_rationale: Subjective adjustments that may signal earnings quality issues or shifting business expectations.

categories.name: Quantitative Change
categories.definition: Changes in numerical figures such as debt principal amounts, contractual maturity schedules, lease liabilities, or segment operating margins.
categories.materiality_rationale: Routine financial progression or updates to balance sheet balances.

categories.name: Reclassification
categories.definition: Shifting of items between balance sheet or income statement line items or segment definitions.
categories.materiality_rationale: Distorts historical trend analysis unless restated.

categories.name: Language Change
categories.definition: Substantive alterations in descriptive phrasing, conditional wording (e.g., 'probable' changed to 'possible'), or tone.
categories.materiality_rationale: May indicate subtle shifts in legal posture or executive sentiment.

HIGH.definition: Material disclosures capable of altering valuation, leverage ratios, risk profiles, or compliance standing.
HIGH.analyst_sla: Requires immediate analyst review within same trading session.

MEDIUM.definition: Notable operational, structural, or estimate adjustments that do not immediately threaten financial solvency.
MEDIUM.analyst_sla: Review during standard quarterly earnings model update.

LOW.definition: Minor language, technical, or standard recurring updates.
LOW.analyst_sla: Informational only; examine at analyst discretion.
